with cohort as (
 select execution_id,target_code,status,started_at from public.lf_operation_execution
 where operation_code='EJECUCION_PERFIL_LF'
 and target_code in ('PERFIL-PRODUCT-DIRECTOR-LF','PERFIL-QUALITY-PACK','PERFIL-SYSTEMIC-ROOT-CAUSE-REPAIR-LF','PERFIL-UI-ARCHITECT')
 order by started_at desc limit 20
), steps as (
 select c.execution_id, count(*) filter(where s.status='STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE') as pass_steps,
 count(*) filter(where s.status='STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE' and nullif(btrim(s.evidence_ref),'') is null) as pass_missing_evidence_ref,
 count(*) filter(where s.status='STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE' and (jsonb_typeof(s.evidence_payload) is distinct from 'object' or s.evidence_payload='{}'::jsonb)) as pass_empty_payload,
 bool_or(s.step_order=80 and s.evidence_payload->>'ig_findings_reported'='true') as ig_reported,
 count(*) filter(where s.step_order=80) as step80_count
 from cohort c left join public.lf_operation_execution_steps s using(execution_id) group by c.execution_id
), inv as (
 select i.parent_execution_id execution_id,count(*) as ig_invocations
 from public.lf_skill_invocation_v1 i join cohort c on c.execution_id=i.parent_execution_id
 where i.skill_code='INPUT_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT_PACK' group by i.parent_execution_id
)
select c.*,s.pass_steps,s.pass_missing_evidence_ref,s.pass_empty_payload,
coalesce(s.ig_reported,false) ig_reported,s.step80_count,coalesce(i.ig_invocations,0) ig_invocations
from cohort c join steps s using(execution_id) left join inv i using(execution_id) order by c.started_at desc;
joins: cohort LEFT JOIN steps por execution_id
cohort LEFT JOIN invocations por parent_execution_id

run_sample.query:
with cohort as (
 select execution_id,target_code,status,started_at from public.lf_operation_execution
 where operation_code='EJECUCION_PERFIL_LF'
 and target_code in ('PERFIL-PRODUCT-DIRECTOR-LF','PERFIL-QUALITY-PACK','PERFIL-SYSTEMIC-ROOT-CAUSE-REPAIR-LF','PERFIL-UI-ARCHITECT')
 order by started_at desc limit 20
), steps as (
 select c.execution_id, count(*) filter(where s.status='STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE') as pass_steps,
 count(*) filter(where s.status='STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE' and nullif(btrim(s.evidence_ref),'') is null) as pass_missing_evidence_ref,
 count(*) filter(where s.status='STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE' and (jsonb_typeof(s.evidence_payload) is distinct from 'object' or s.evidence_payload='{}'::jsonb)) as pass_empty_payload,
 bool_or(s.step_order=80 and s.evidence_payload->>'ig_findings_reported'='true') as ig_reported,
 count(*) filter(where s.step_order=80) as step80_count
 from cohort c left join public.lf_operation_execution_steps s using(execution_id) group by c.execution_id
), inv as (
 select i.parent_execution_id execution_id,count(*) as ig_invocations
 from public.lf_skill_invocation_v1 i join cohort c on c.execution_id=i.parent_execution_id
 where i.skill_code='INPUT_GOVERNANCE_CONTEXT_PACK' group by i.parent_execution_id
)
select c.*,s.pass_steps,s.pass_missing_evidence_ref,s.pass_empty_payload,
coalesce(s.ig_reported,false) ig_reported,s.step80_count,coalesce(i.ig_invocations,0) ig_invocations
from cohort c join steps s using(execution_id) left join inv i using(execution_id) order by c.started_at desc;
